bagPolicy.summary: Chaifetz Arena allows one clear bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" and one small clutch up to 7.5" x 5.0" per guest. Bags are subject to search for a safer and quicker entry.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Diaper bags with child after inspection
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection.

parking.note: A variety of covered and uncovered parking areas are available, including the Olive/Compton Garage, Laclede Garage, and Fred Weber VIP Lot. All parking is cashless, accepting only major credit/debit cards. Plan ahead and arrive early to avoid traffic.

rideshare.note: Use 3402 Laclede Avenue, St. Louis, as your rideshare pickup and drop-off address.

concessions.note: Chaifetz Arena offers a diverse range of food and beverage options through Delaware North Catering. Highlights include Mexican cuisine at Blue Agave, Italian favorites at Midtown Italiano, and award-winning BBQ from Blue Flame BBQ. Alcoholic beverages are available for guests over 21, and all sales are cashless.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Chaifetz Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is normally prohibited. Some all-day events allow it. Medical or other special exceptions require manager approval. Approved guests must have tickets scanned out and back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Chaifetz Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors open about one hour before the event. Not every gate is used for every event. Gates A and C are the preferred accessible entrances.
